code: withr::local_options(list(flexyBayes.silence_default_prior_note = TRUE)) hub_fit <- flexyBayes::flexybayes(   y ~ 1 + (1 | g), data = data_toy, backend = "inla", verbose = FALSE,   seed = 1L ) #> flexyBayes: `seed` is a Stan sampler setting the INLA backend does not use, so it has no effect on this fit. code: if (requireNamespace("kernR", quietly = TRUE)) {   register_kernr_surrogates()   set.seed(1)   a <- runif(80, -2, 2)   e <- fb_ensemble(     params = data.frame(a = a),     outputs = data.frame(y = sin(a) + rnorm(80, 0, 0.05)),     provenance = list(source = "raw")   )   s <- fit_surrogate(e, method = "cme", lambda = 1e-2)   predict(s, data.frame(a = 0.5))   # far outside the design the conformer declines rather than guessing:   tryCatch(     predict(s, data.frame(a = 40)),     fb_surrogate_cme_abstention = function(cnd) conditionMessage(cnd)   ) } #> [1] "the 'cme' surrogate declines to predict at 1 of the supplied point(s): the conditional-mean smoother carries a weight mass of 6.41e-258 there (row 1), below the out-of-support floor 0.434. On the training design the mass runs 0.867 to 1.004; as a point leaves the design the kernel evaluations decay to zero, the smoother mean collapses toward zero and the linear-smoother variance sigma^2 (1 + ||w||^2) collapses to its in-design floor -- a confident wrong answer.
